questions.q: What's the [best thing] about living in a big city?
s: {The [best] thing about} living in a big city {is} that there's always something to do.
{What I [love] about} the city {is} that you can go out without a car.
{The [great] thing about} big cities {is that} you meet people from everywhere.
{One [good] thing about} city life {is} that there are loads of concerts.
{Another [plus] is that} the shops stay open really late.
{On the plus [side],} you never get bored at the weekend.
